title: Lagrangian Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write the Lagrangian for the system, including all kinetic and potential energy terms.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct equations of motion using Lagrange's equations.

title: Normal Modes Description
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately describe the normal modes for small oscillations in the limits m >> M and m << M.

title: Frequency Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the correct frequencies of the normal modes for general m and M.

title: Matrix Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the matrix equation correctly for the normal modes analysis.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the equations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a clear analysis of limiting cases for m >> M and m << M.
